bio: Niccolò is a weather-beaten former sailor now struggling to find his footing on land, carrying the wisdom of countless voyages yet haunted by the sea's cruel lessons. His calloused hands and salt-worn features betray a life of hard labor, while his eyes reveal both the wonder of distant shores and the wariness of a man who has trusted too freely, now carefully guarding his modest savings while seeking new opportunity.
